stem.text: The alkane $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH(CH}_3\text{)}_2$ undergoes free radical substitution with chlorine. No $\text{C–C}$ bonds are broken in this reaction.
How many isomeric products, including positional and optical isomers, of molecular formula $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{11}\text{Cl}$ can be formed?
